ops.title: Commander-authorised scope extension: correct the five gated-only doc claims
ops.imperative: Under the Commander's explicit ruling on tc1, correct the five enumerated sites so they describe what the engine now does: amend applies to gated checklists, and retext-check is additionally available on a survey where it is the ONLY permitted op (add/drop/rescope stay gated-only as a conservative choice). Then re-grep to confirm no SIXTH site says gated-only, re-run the full suite for a real exit code, and append a Scope extension section to IMPLEMENTER_RESULT.md.

postconditions.statement: no remaining site claims amend is gated-only; both files describe the survey retext-check allowance

postconditions.statement: full suite green after the doc correction; Scope extension section appended to IMPLEMENTER_RESULT.md
